body:
## What happens
`bench/canary/lib/chat.sh` waits for the literal `' · idle'` on the v3 status line before it types the brief, and `chat_asked_frame` looks for `[a] accept` on a card. Neither string exists on `dev` (`f08201024`) any more. Every chat cell therefore records `noframe` after 61 s having spent nothing, and a grid run against `dev` reports a wall of empty cells that look like model failures.

## Replication a stranger can run
```sh
make build
AFORGE_MODE=chat bench/run.sh --issue pallets/click#3481 --model deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash --runs 1
grep -l noframe bench/out/*/cell.json
```
Compare with `tmux capture-pane` of a live `bin/aforge chat`: the idle status line no longer contains ` · idle`.

## Acceptance, end to end first
A chat cell against `dev` reaches the model: `cell.json` carries a non-zero `cost` and `calls.jsonl` has at least one priced row, on the same command above. The needles the canary waits for come out of the same table the e2e suite reads (`internal/e2e/tuiwords_test.go`) or a sibling that an untagged test checks against `internal/tui3` sources, so the next respelling names the canary instead of silently emptying the grid.

Found by the 2026-09-14 PlanDB A/B grid; the lane patched `chat.sh` locally to run at all (`spark:~/af-plandb-evidence/rig-local-patch.diff`). Related: #1028 (fix-branch leak in `fresh_clone`).

labels.name: good first issue
labels.description: Small and isolated, the acceptance already written, no ruling owed; a safe first pull request

title: bench canary: the chat door waits for a status line dev no longer spells, so every chat cell records noframe
